text_block_list.name: Male Photographer
text_block_list.text: The Mejiro Family Calendar... A calendar created by the Mejiro family, where horse girls carrying the Mejiro name adorn all 12 months.

text_block_list.name: Male Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's begin the calendar shoot!
Today will be the photoshoot for December!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a lovely set!
It's perfect for the Christmas theme!

text_block_list.name: Male Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu-san, thank you for agreeing to my unreasonable request as well.
Usually, it's just you in your racing silk on the track, but... I desperately wanted a shot with both of you together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I do not mind.
Please, proceed as you wish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Your passion to capture this shot came through loud and clear, Mr. Photographer!
Alright, I'll give it my all too!

text_block_list.name: Male Photographer
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's a wrap for this shot! Please take a seat on these chairs until the next setup!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (! Ramonu-san's heel is broken...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (Someone like Ramonu-san probably doesn't need anyone's help... But—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is taking that one step forward...
I'm sure you can support her, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(That's right...
I'm going to—!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Mr. Photographer! Could you please get a spare pair of shoes for Ramonu-san?
It looks like her heel broke.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu-san.
...If it's alright with you—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Please, take my hand.
I'll escort you to the chair.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: O-Only if it isn't a bother, of course...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Very well. Lead the way.

text_block_list.name: Male Photographer
text_block_list.text: Shot in front of the tree is good to go! Alright, next up is in the garden—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Male Photographer
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...? My apologies Ramonu-san, is there an issue on our end...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ! ...Pardon me, Ramonu-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I thought so, the gloves were too tight for you. I have a spare pair, so let's swap them out—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You certainly notice the finest details.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... I'm meddling a bit too much, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But... I hated staying frozen without the courage to act.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I still have a long way to go before I can truly support you, Ramonu-san. ...However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: At the very least, I want to stand tall by your side with pride!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Neither bowing nor yielding.
Just pure sincerity...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: While your timid self was endearing as well—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: It seems you can play the escort after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*Click!*)

text_block_list.name: Male Photographer
text_block_list.text: Both of your expressions just now were phenomenal! Man, I think next year's calendar cover is decided right here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted a horse girl calling out
to Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I have been invited.
...Were you aware?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, to the ballroom dance party, right!
If I recall, it's full of distinguished families... I'm
sure it'll suit you wonderfully, Ramonu-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Do you know how to lead?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh—Y-Yes, ma'am!
Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Heheh...♪ I'll do my absolute best
to escort you, Ramonu-san!
